sentences.en: He bestowed a large amount of money on the institute.
sentences.zh: 他向研究所捐赠了一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Countervailing opinions have sadly prevented me from instituting martial law.
sentences.zh: 反制意见使我未能宣布 Martial 法令。

sentences.en: A new classroom building was built in our institute last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我们学院建起了一栋新的教室楼。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（使…）+stitut（建立）+e →建立，设立
